openings.claim: Tags may leave pattern quantities dependent on memory. Pencil pattern/counts on envelopes and tick after insertion; exterior marks also expose assignment. Rare sample use and shared-material omissions motivate this, without locating omissions.
openings.discriminator: Compare cues with unchanged shared trays against loose local staging without cues. Effective staging but ineffective cues challenges memory dominance; incomplete correctly ticked envelopes defeat insertion checking. O4 challenges tagged-tray necessity.
openings.probe: Same two volunteers alternate three matched four-kit batches: incumbent, envelope cues, loose staging. Cap preparation, assembly and sample-based audit at 18 minutes; tally crossings, time and omissions; stop if staging exceeds table.
openings.uncertainty: Legibility, staging footprint and cap feasibility unknown. O4 mixture unknown; omission stage unresolved. Assignment exchanges may fall independently of completeness. Full-session success unproven.

openings.claim: Short same-pattern runs, sample consultation at each run start and personal counts before closure may reduce switching-related omissions and combined assembly/check time, retaining shared trays.
openings.discriminator: Matched grouped runs must improve both omissions and combined time; unchanged omissions or equal/greater time defeats joint improvement. Material-access causes predict little improvement with unchanged trays.
openings.probe: Compare ordinary assembly/final checking with grouped assembly/preclosure checking in two matched six-kit lots from required kits; counterbalance volunteer participation, keep trays fixed, audit missing items and time. Cap comparison/corrections at 20 minutes within 90; stop at table/time limits.
openings.uncertainty: Preserves describes bounded probe. Matched allocation, counting reliability and cost unverified; O4 mixture unknown. Sixty-kit success unproven.

lineage.reason: Preserves quantity-memory, insertion-check and exterior-assignment relations plus spatial rival.
Preserves switching-frequency and human-check-timing relations separately.

decision: Test separately; all evidence is synthetic, effects unestablished. Retain specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, 90 minutes, 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing envelopes/supplies without purchases. Target 60 ready kits and at most one distribution correction. Neither opening resolves colour shortage despite unopened stock; opened-packet area remains unknown.
